what: One planted uncaught error on the deployed command post, to show the web app's crash reports reach Crashlytics with the error's text removed.
how: Google Chrome driven by Playwright opened the site with the App Check debug token, waited 3 s, then added a script (a blob: URL) that throws a TypeError from a function named crashlyticsLiveTestError on the next tick. Nothing else was done on the page.
alsoLogged: A DEBUG entry in the same log at the same timestamp (the SDK's own event, text only).
notMeasured: Whether the Crashlytics SDK code was downloaded only after the error: the run's pattern for that file did not match its built name, so this run does not show it.
read: The entries were read with gcloud logging read (read-only) about 2 minutes after the plant.
